name: gemini
label: Gemini CLI
install: Install the Gemini CLI (npm i -g @google/gemini-cli) and set GEMINI_API_KEY or sign in
auth: GEMINI_API_KEY (the same key the image step uses). A cached Google login wins over the key, so set "security.auth.selectedType": "gemini-api-key" in ~/.gemini/settings.json. The Google login itself no longer works for unpaid-tier and Google One accounts: Google replaced the CLI with Antigravity for them on 2026-06-18.
_toolPolicy: No per-tool allowlist and every call auto-approved (yolo): the prompt's contract is the only rule.
_prompt: -p with an empty value: the prompt on stdin is appended to it.

verified.liveRunNote: short-story, 2026-10-26: 3,540 words in 5 min, default model, GEMINI_API_KEY
